other_conditions: States/UTs must enact legislation to issue a single trade licence valid across the whole state for any eligible person, irrespective of domicile
States/UTs must implement a single point levy of market fee for wholesale trading of agricultural produce, with no additional fees on subsequent transactions
States/UTs must provide for e‑auction/e‑trading as a mode of price discovery in their markets
States/UTs must submit proposals (Annexure‑I) to receive a one‑time grant for hardware, internet connection, assaying equipment and related infrastructure
States/UTs must ensure that 100 % of selected agricultural commodities are traded through e‑trading/e‑auction in the covered markets
States/UTs must make provision for or link to Soil Testing Laboratories (STLs) in close proximity to markets
States/UTs must meet any balance fund requirements, bear future escalations after five years, and fund annual software maintenance thereafter
The implementing agency must be registered on the PFMS portal and notify the Department of Agriculture, Cooperation and Farmers’ Welfare with bank details for fund transfers
benefits_summary: Provides a unified online platform for agricultural trade, enabling transparent price discovery, wider market access and efficient transactions for farmers and traders.
